All services are delivered digitally and at scale.

products.name: Job Distribution Services
products.description: A service that distributes employer job postings from ZipRecruiter to a network of third-party job boards, search engines, social networks, and talent communities, expanding the reach of job listings. This is managed digitally through partnerships and integrations.

products.name: Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
products.description: A cloud-based software tool provided to employers to centralize, review, rate, and manage job applicants, either as a standalone solution or integrated with third-party ATS platforms. Delivered as a digital SaaS product.

products.name: AI-Powered Career Advisor for Job Seekers
products.description: A digital, AI-driven assistant ('Phil') that provides personalized job recommendations, application guidance, and proactive engagement to job seekers throughout their job search journey, delivered via web and mobile interfaces.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides commercial real estate loans (owner-occupied and non-owner occupied), commercial and industrial loans, and specialized loans to dental and medical practices. These loans are originated and underwritten by in-house staff, secured by business assets or real estate, and delivered through physical branches and loan production offices.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Offers adjustable-rate and fixed-rate one- to four-family residential real estate loans, primarily secured by properties in the bank's primary market area. Loans are underwritten to internal and Fannie Mae guidelines and delivered through branch and loan production offices.

products.name: Construction and Land Lending
products.description: Provides loans for residential and commercial construction projects, as well as land loans for development or investment. These loans are underwritten based on project appraisals and borrower qualifications, and are delivered through in-person banking channels.

products.name: Indirect Automobile Lending
products.description: Through the Affinity Bank Dealer Select division, purchases retail installment sales contracts from auto dealerships across several states. Loans are underwritten for creditworthiness and vehicle value, and delivered via dealer partnerships rather than direct to consumer.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans including loans secured by deposit accounts, unsecured personal loans, and direct auto loans, primarily to customers with existing relationships. Underwriting is based on creditworthiness and collateral, and loans are delivered through branch offices.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and individual retirement accounts. Accounts are offered through physical branches and a nationwide virtual bank (FitnessBank), with some products featuring rewards or fitness-based interest rates.

products.name: Investment Securities
products.description: Invests in and manages a portfolio of securities including U.S. government and agency securities, mortgage-backed securities, municipal and corporate bonds. These investments are managed for liquidity and return, not directly sold to customers.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Laundry Equipment
products.description: Distribution and leasing of commercial and industrial laundry equipment, including washers, dryers, tunnel systems, vended machines, finishing equipment, material handling equipment, and mechanical equipment. Products are sourced from manufacturers and delivered to customers, often tailored to order.

products.name: Boilers and Power Generation Products
products.description: Distribution of boilers, hot water/steam systems, and power generation products used for temperature control, heating, pressing, sterilization, and other industrial purposes. These are sourced from manufacturers and delivered to customers in various industries.

products.name: Water Purification, Reuse, and Recycling Systems
products.description: Distribution of water purification, reuse, and recycling systems designed to reduce utility and water consumption in commercial and industrial laundry operations. These systems are sourced from manufacturers and integrated into customer facilities.

products.name: Replacement Parts and Accessories
products.description: Sale of replacement parts and accessories for the laundry equipment, boilers, and related systems distributed by the company. Inventory is maintained for rapid delivery to meet customer needs.

products.name: Installation, Maintenance, and Repair Services
products.description: Provision of installation, maintenance, and repair services for commercial laundry equipment, boilers, and related systems, performed by a network of trained technicians. Services are delivered on-site at customer locations.

products.name: Planning, Design, and Consulting Services
products.description: Advisory and technical services including planning, designing, and consulting for commercial laundry operations, delivered by the company's sales and technical staff to optimize customer facilities.

products.name: Commercial Human Spaceflight for Private Individuals
products.description: Virgin Galactic offers suborbital spaceflights for private individuals, providing a multi-day experience including astronaut training and a flight to space with several minutes of weightlessness and views of Earth. The service is delivered using proprietary, reusable spaceships and launch vehicles, operated from Spaceport America.

products.name: Suborbital Research and Payload Flights
products.description: The company provides suborbital spaceflight services for researchers, government agencies, and educational institutions, enabling both autonomous and human-tended experiments in microgravity. This includes flying scientific payloads and researchers to space, with end-to-end support including payload lockers and campaign management.

products.name: Engineering and Aerospace Development Services
products.description: Virgin Galactic occasionally offers engineering services to third parties, including research, design, development, manufacturing, and integration of advanced aerospace technology systems. These services leverage the company's expertise in spacecraft and propulsion system development and are delivered as bespoke projects for commercial and government clients.

products.name: Rocket Motor and Propulsion System Sales
products.description: The company develops and manufactures hybrid rocket motors and propulsion systems, with the potential to offer these products and related technology to external customers for commercial, research, or government applications. Production is supported by dedicated facilities and expertise in rocket system integration and testing.

products.name: Avionics Systems and Solutions
products.description: Virgin Galactic has developed advanced avionics systems for its spacecraft and is positioned to offer avionics solutions and related electronic engineering services to other aerospace industry clients, leveraging its proprietary technology and expertise.

products.name: Mattresses
products.description: Manufactured and sold under brands such as Tempur-Pedic, Sealy, Stearns & Foster, Sleepy's, and non-branded/OEM, these mattresses include traditional innerspring, foam, hybrid, airbed, and latex types, produced in company-owned facilities and distributed globally through retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Foundations and Adjustable Bed Bases
products.description: Manufactured and sourced from third-party suppliers, these include traditional and adjustable foundations and bed bases, sold alongside mattresses to provide support and customization, distributed through retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Pillows and Bedding Accessories
products.description: Manufactured and sold under various brands, these products include pillows (foam, feather, visco-elastic, latex, gel, rubber, down) and other bedding accessories, distributed through retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Retail Bedding Stores and E-Commerce Platforms
products.description: Operation of company-owned and franchised retail stores (e.g., Mattress Firm, Dreams, Tempur-Pedic retail stores, SOVA) and e-commerce platforms, selling mattresses, foundations, pillows, and accessories directly to consumers through physical and digital channels.

products.name: OEM and Private Label Bedding Products
products.description: Manufacture and supply of non-branded and private label mattresses, pillows, and bedding components to third-party retailers, expanding reach beyond proprietary brands and capturing manufacturing profits from external brands.

products.name: Licensing of Bedding Brands and Technology
products.description: Licensing of proprietary brands (Sealy, Stearns & Foster, Tempur) and technology to third-party manufacturers and retailers, generating royalty and franchise revenue through brand and technology use in designated jurisdictions.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to small and mid-sized companies, including commercial and industrial loans and commercial real estate loans, primarily within the regional service area. Lending is supported by strong underwriting, collateral control, and personal guarantees.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Offers mortgage loans for residential properties, including origination, servicing, and periodic sale of loans into the secondary market. Loans are primarily sourced from local communities and may be sold to government agencies such as Freddie Mac.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides consumer installment loans, home equity financing, and indirect auto loans sourced through a network of automobile dealers across New York and Vermont. Loans are primarily to individuals for personal, family, or household purposes.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a variety of deposit products to consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, and other transactional accounts, primarily through a network of bank branches in the communities served.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Provides retirement planning, trust and estate administration for individuals, and pension, profit-sharing, and employee benefit plan administration for corporations, delivered through trust operations and a registered investment adviser subsidiary.

products.name: Insurance Agency Services
products.description: Offers insurance products and services through a licensed insurance agency subsidiary, operating from dedicated insurance offices and regulated by state insurance authorities.

products.name: Legacy Networking Solutions
products.description: Carrier-grade networking solutions providing address and protocol translation, session management, and policy controls for large-scale service provider and enterprise environments. Delivered as hardware appliances, virtual appliances, or software, these are physically manufactured and deployed in customer networks.

products.name: Next-Generation Networking Solutions
products.description: Application delivery and traffic management solutions for modern data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed architectures. Includes server load balancing, global load distribution, SSL/TLS acceleration, and application-level observability, delivered as hardware, software, or cloud-native offerings.

products.name: Network Security Solutions (A10 Defend)
products.description: Integrated network security solutions providing DDoS detection and mitigation, web application and API protection, bot mitigation, and threat intelligence. Delivered as hardware, software, or cloud-based services, these solutions protect applications and infrastructure from cyber threats.

products.name: Maintenance and Support Services
products.description: Technical support, maintenance, hardware repair, software updates, and training services for customers deploying the company's networking and security products. Delivered by in-person and remote technical professionals, often bundled with product sales and renewable via contract.

products.name: Mineral and Royalty Interests in Oil and Natural Gas Properties
products.description: Ownership and acquisition of mineral and royalty interests in oil and natural gas properties, primarily in the Permian Basin, which generate royalty income from third-party operators' production. The company does not operate wells or bear operating or development costs; it receives cash flows based on production volumes and lease royalty terms.

products.name: Payload Protection and Deployment Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures the top section of boosters, launch vehicles, payloads, or missile systems, including shrouds and fairings, using advanced materials and proprietary manufacturing processes. Delivered as highly engineered, mission-critical hardware for space and defense applications.

products.name: Aerodynamic Interstage Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures metallic and composite subsystems that enhance aerodynamics and enable interstage separation for missiles and launch vehicles, produced through precision engineering and advanced materials expertise.

products.name: Propulsion Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and integrates solid rocket motors, subsystems for liquid-fueled rocket motors, launch systems, and ablative composites, using proprietary energetics and advanced manufacturing processes for missile and space launch applications.
